reading.title: The Path Above the Tide
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述女孩夜海求生的原文，而是换到一次海边步行：雾和潮水让低处路线变危险，孩子根据 coastguard 提示、cliff path 和前方灯光选择安全方向。
passage: On a cloudy afternoon, Maya and her younger cousin set out from a small car park near the coast. They wanted to follow the shore path to the old picnic field, but the wind grew colder and a thick fog came in from the sea. Soon the tide covered part of the lower path, and they could not see the beach clearly. Maya remembered the coastguard notice: stay above the tide and follow the marked cliff path. They climbed carefully, keeping the fence on their left. After covering a distance of two miles, they saw a light ahead at the lifeboat station. They walked towards it and told an adult what had happened. They were tired, but they had chosen the safe path.

questions.question: Where did Maya and her cousin set out from?
options: A small car park near the coast.
A fishing boat in the middle of the sea.
A hospital below the cliffs.
A classroom beside a river.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文第一句说 they set out from a small car park near the coast。

questions.question: What made the lower path unsafe?
options: A thick fog came in, and the tide covered part of the lower path.
The picnic field was closed for the winter.
The lifeboat station had turned off its light.
Their car broke down on the road.
questions.explanation_zh: 问题来自两个细节：thick fog came in from the sea，而且 the tide covered part of the lower path。

questions.question: What helped Maya choose the safe direction?
options: A coastguard notice and the marked cliff path.
A map of the old picnic field only.
A stranger asking them to go down to the shore.
A small boat waiting near the rocks.
questions.explanation_zh: Maya remembered the coastguard notice，并选择 follow the marked cliff path。

questions.question: How did they reach an adult safely?
options: They walked towards the light at the lifeboat station and told an adult.
They swam across the sea until morning.
They waited on the lower path for the tide to fall.
They climbed down the cliff to find a cave.
questions.explanation_zh: 他们 saw a light ahead at the lifeboat station，然后 walked towards it and told an adult。

questions.question: Why is this passage about direction and survival without copying Lesson 33?
options: It uses a new coast-walk problem where safe judgment, signs, and a light guide them.
It repeats the girl in a boat swimming all night.
It says dangerous swimming is an exciting game.
It changes the story into a shop detective mystery.
questions.explanation_zh: 这篇短文换成 coast walk、fog、tide 和 cliff path，没有复述原文的 boat、rock、whole night swim。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 33 的方向和时间顺序结构：用 Nearly ... passed before ... 写延迟说明，用 set out from ... 写出发点，用 was caught in ... 写突然陷入麻烦，用 after spending ... 写长时间之后的动作，再用 On arriving at ..., ... 写正式的先后顺序。

patterns.title: Nearly ... passed before ...
patterns.source: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个结构写“过了多久之后才……”，适合表达一个人需要休息、恢复或整理思路之后才能说明情况。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写几分钟、几小时或几天过去了，某人才终于解释发生了什么。
patterns.sample: Nearly two hours passed before Maya could explain what had happened.
patterns.tip_zh: Nearly 后面接时间长度；passed before 后面接一个完整小句，说明后来才发生的事。

patterns.title: set out from ...
patterns.source: She set out from the coast in a small boat.
patterns.focus_zh: set out from 强调旅程的起点，比 started 更有路线感。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人从海岸、学校、车站或营地出发，并补出要去哪里。
patterns.sample: We set out from the school gate and walked towards the museum.
patterns.tip_zh: from 后面写出发地点；后面可以用 towards 或 to 写方向。

patterns.title: was caught in ...
patterns.source: She was caught in a storm.
patterns.focus_zh: was caught in 表示突然陷入某种天气、麻烦或困难局面，不是主动选择。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人突然遇上大雨、雾、交通堵塞或别的麻烦。
patterns.sample: Our class was caught in heavy rain on the way back.
patterns.tip_zh: caught in 后面常接 weather 或 trouble，比如 a storm, heavy rain, traffic。

patterns.title: after spending ...
patterns.source: She swam to the shore after spending the whole night in the water.
patterns.focus_zh: after spending ... 把“花了很久经历某事”放在动作前，突出艰难的过程。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人在等待、寻找、练习或走路很久之后，终于到达或完成一件事。
patterns.sample: Leo reached the bus stop after spending an hour in the rain.
patterns.tip_zh: after spending 后面接时间或一段经历，再写后来完成的动作。

patterns.title: On arriving at ..., ...
patterns.source: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff.
patterns.focus_zh: On arriving at ... 是比较正式的时间顺序表达，意思是“一到……就……”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人一到安全地点、车站、学校或家里，就立刻做了什么。
patterns.sample: On arriving at the station, we called our teacher for help.
patterns.tip_zh: On arriving at 后面接地点，逗号后写到达后马上发生的动作。
